description: 24 paired stories / 48 cases benchmark dataset with development and held-out splits

verification_details.family_retention: Story families kept together strictly across development (Families 1-12) and held-out splits (Families 13-24).
verification_details.edge_cases_covered: Duplicate receipts, legitimate partial allocation, receipt vs prior inclusion, accepted/unaccepted returns, channel ambiguity, conditional promises, late receipts, route shortages, fees, reserve infeasibility, stale drafts, concurrent allocations, gateway replay, amount tampering, conflicting dates, unreadable sources, and RBAC.
verification_details.controls_preserved: Clean cash/digital sales, debt collections with zero revenue inflation, and appropriate no-reply unresolved controls.
